photos.desc: Adult female Pennant-winged Nightjar killed on road, 1 km south of Creighton, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa

An immature Pennant-winged Nightjar captured in exhausted condition near Shamvura Camp, northern Namibia, Jan 13, 2007. Revived and later released. Mensural data : tarsus 20.0mm, culmen 20.5mm, wing 1
